svg.title: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
svg.desc: Timing temporarily swaps only tidy's provider, leaving other modules active. Clang-tidy must be enabled; a missing module produces an error. Provider allocation and both swaps are outside the measured Time() block. The local variable saves the original provider; scope exit restores it.
svg.text: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
Timing temporarily swaps only tidy's provider, leaving other modules active. Clang-tidy must be enabled; a missing module produces an error.
// Keep all other modules active while varying only tidy's configuration.
elog("Cannot time clang-tidy checks without a clang-tidy feature module");
// Provider now holds the original configuration; restore it on exit.
Provider allocation and both swaps are outside the measured Time() block.
The local variable saves the original provider; scope exit restores it.
Source: 101584320859 → c64f1fca38c6 • Exact snapshots; arrows map responsibilities, not every line
